$description: The one empty-state pattern (studio-ui-guidelines.md §11), as the document every region draws it from. Nine surfaces had already copied it into their own JSON — `git-panel.json`, `logic-panel.json`, `panel-outline.json` and the rest each carry a `[part="empty"]` block written from the same rules — because `panels/empty-state.ts` is a lit template a document cannot call. This is the copy those were waiting for: the region that has NO document of its own hands its box to this one instead of rendering the helper, so a shell with three surfaces still lit and eight converted has one empty state rather than two. The copy rules stay where they are stated, in `panels/empty-state.ts`'s header: one sentence saying what the region is FOR, the action that fills it, and one shared verb across equivalent surfaces. Nothing here decides any of them — the adapter is handed a message, an optional second sentence and a list of buttons, and this draws exactly that.

style.$description: What `.empty-state`, `.empty-state--teach`, `.empty-state-message`, `.empty-state-detail`, `.empty-state-actions`, `.empty-state-action` and the `--compact` pair said across `styles/overlays.css` and `styles/panels.css`, keyed on `part`. Neither stylesheet loses its rules: `ui/expression-editor.ts` still renders the lit helper for its own compact state, so this is a copy until that surface converts. Two values did not travel. `.empty-state`'s `font-size: 13px` was a number nothing else in the shell uses and is the kit's `--jx-text-md`; `.empty-state-detail`'s `var(--spectrum-font-size-50, 11px)` resolves only inside `<sp-theme>`, and a document mounted into a Navigator body or a canvas stage is outside it, so it would silently have taken its hard-coded fallback on every paint — it is `--jx-text-sm`, which is the step it was.

& [part=\"empty-detail\"].$description: The second sentence: where the region's content comes from. Dimmer than the first, because the first is the one a reader has to take in.

&[data-compact].$description: An inline section inside an otherwise populated panel — tighter and left-aligned, because it sits directly above its own add form rather than filling a region on its own.
